get.summary: Lab-workflow statistics for a facility over a time period
get.description: Counts orders sent, orders acknowledged, and results received (total / valid / unsolicited) for one facility. The period defaults to the last 30 days when `from`/`to` are omitted; both bounds are inclusive dates.

parameters.name: mflCode
parameters.description: Facility MFL code to scope the statistics to

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window (inclusive, ISO date). Defaults to 29 days before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window (inclusive, ISO date). Defaults to today (UTC).

get.summary: Download the lab-order turn-around-time report (.xlsx)
get.description: One row per lab order for the facility, joined to its acknowledgement and current result. Tat is the order-to-result turn-around time (days + hours). Optionally bounded by an inclusive [from, to] date window on when the order was placed.

parameters.name: mflCode
parameters.description: Facility MFL code to scope the report to

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window (inclusive, ISO date). Omit for no lower bound.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window (inclusive, ISO date). Omit for no upper bound.
